seoTitle: Fraction Visualizer: Pie and Bar Models with Comparison
metaDescription: Draw fractions like 3/8 as shaded circle slices and bars, compare two fractions and see the decimal and lowest terms. Free.
intro: Draws each fraction as a pie and a bar, converts it to lowest terms, mixed number and decimal, and compares two fractions.
why:
Fractions make more sense when you can see them. Type 3/8 and see 3 of 8 slices shaded; type 3/8, 1/2 and the tool draws both and explains the comparison by cross-multiplying.

Mixed numbers like 1 3/4 are drawn as full circles plus a part. Denominators up to 24 and values up to 4 are supported to keep the drawings readable. The text lines give the lowest terms, the mixed number and the exact decimal.
howTo: Type one fraction, or several separated by commas.
With two fractions the comparison is added.
Read the lines under the drawing.
